title: Baseline TPU v5p profiles (`per_device_batch_size=1`, `max_target_length=4096`) show training step time is dominated by Gated DeltaNet triangular solves (44%) and QSA indexer mask gathers (28%), followed by MoE 512-expert collectives (9%) and MoE ragged-dot compute (3%), while dense QSA attention takes 0.2% (but drives peak HBM).
